details:
Description

Please add an option to disable tapping on other players' avatars to open their quick menu on mobile.

Currently, there are two major issues when playing on mobile:

When swiping/dragging the screen to rotate the camera, accidentally touching nearby players opens their menu.

When tapping to pick up or interact with objects, if another player walks across the screen, it accidentally selects that player and triggers their menu instead.

This creates severe usability issues and constant frustration during mobile gameplay. Adding a toggle to turn off direct avatar tapping for menus on mobile would greatly improve the experience.

Reproduction Steps

Open VRChat on a mobile device.

Join a world with other players.

Attempt to drag/swipe the screen to rotate the camera while standing near other players.

Alternatively, attempt to tap to pick up or interact with an object when another player walks by.

Observe that tapping/touching another player's avatar opens their quick menu, disrupting camera rotation or object interaction.
